top5_headlines.summary: 구윤철 부총리, 30일 확대 거시경제금융회의 개최 美 FOMC 금리 동결 영향 점검…향후 대응책 논의 "연준, 시장 예상대로 금리 동결…불확실성 지속" [서울=뉴시스] 배훈식 기자 = 구윤철 경제부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관이 30일 오전 서울 중구 은행회관에서 열린 확대 거시경제 금융회의에서 발언하고 있다.

top5_headlines.title: 1분기 국세수입 108.8조 … 1년새 16.7%↑

top5_headlines.title: 3월 생산·소비·투자 ‘ 트리플 증가 ’ “중동전쟁 영향 4~5월 본격화 전...
top5_headlines.summary: 반도체 기저효과 생산감소, 업황 견조 금융·소비회복 조짐, 내수 지표 개선 1분기도 성장…주요 6대지표 모두 ↑ 3월 전산업생산과 소비·투자가 모두 늘어나며 반년 만에 ‘트리플 증가’를 기록했다. 중동 전쟁이라는 외부 변수에도 전반적인 경기 흐름은 아직 크게 흔들리지 않은 모습이다.

top5_headlines.title: ‘ 다주택자 편법증여 ’ 내달 9일 이후 고강도 전수조사한다
top5_headlines.summary: 양도세 중과 유예 종료 시점 국세청, 의심물건 검증 강화 최고 40% 가산세 부과 예고 3월 수도권 인허가 36.4% ↓ ‘주택 공급 절벽’ 현실화 우려 국세청이 오는 5월 9일 양도소득세 중과 유예 종료에 맞춰 고가 아파트 편법 증여 의심 사례에 대한 전수조사를 고강도로 실시한다.

key_headlines.title: Korea's Economic Leadership Convenes First Meeting Under New BOK Governor
key_headlines.summary: Deputy Prime Minister Koo Yoon-chul chaired an expanded macroeconomic and financial meeting with the newly appointed BOK Governor Shin Hyun-song and financial regulators, affirming sufficient crisis response capacity amid Middle East tensions and market volatility.

key_headlines.title: LG Energy Solution Secures 10 Trillion Won BMW Battery Supply Contract
key_headlines.summary: LG Energy Solution won a major contract to supply cylindrical batteries worth over 10 trillion won to German automaker BMW for next-generation electric vehicles, marking LG's first battery supply to BMW's pure EV platform.

key_headlines.title: Fed Maintains Rates Amid Internal Divisions on Future Policy Direction
key_headlines.summary: The Federal Reserve held rates steady for the third consecutive time, but three FOMC members dissented from the dovish policy language, signaling increasing uncertainty about future U.S. monetary policy as inflation concerns persist.

key_headlines.title: Samsung Electro-Mechanics Records Strong Q1 Results on AI and Advanced Driver Systems Demand
key_headlines.summary: Samsung Electro-Mechanics achieved robust first-quarter earnings with operating profit up 40% year-on-year, driven by expanding AI server and autonomous vehicle component supplies.

key_headlines.title: Anthropic Seeks 900 Billion Dollar Valuation, Challenging OpenAI's Market Position
key_headlines.summary: AI startup Anthropic is negotiating funding at a 900 billion dollar valuation, more than double its current worth, potentially becoming the world's most valuable AI startup and rivaling OpenAI's market standing.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's economic leadership held their first joint meeting under new Bank of Korea Governor Shin Hyun-song, with Deputy Prime Minister Koo Yoon-chul asserting sufficient crisis response capacity despite Middle East tensions and volatile financial markets. The government activated 24-hour market monitoring systems to address concerns over oil prices, exchange rates, and potential financial sector stress. Q1 GDP growth reached a 5.5-year high while April exports showed significant increases year-on-year. Producer price inflation concerns were addressed, with the President pledging to prevent spillover into consumer prices.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The government expressed confidence in managing economic headwinds from Middle East conflicts and external uncertainties. Q1 GDP growth reached its highest level in five years and six months, while April export growth appears solid despite global challenges. Producer price inflation has become a key concern, though government officials committed to preventing spillover to consumer prices. The new BOK Governor Shin Hyun-song's first macroeconomic meeting signals strengthened policy coordination between financial authorities. Authorities are closely monitoring U.S. monetary policy impacts, particularly the Fed's hawkish rate hold decision and internal divisions within the FOMC.
sections.Financial Markets: The KOSPI declined 1.38% to close at 6598.87 as international oil prices surged and the Fed's hawkish rate hold decision created uncertainty. Foreign investors net sold 1.46 trillion won worth of stocks, while individuals and institutions made net purchases. The KOSDAQ fell 2.29% to 1192.35, and the won-dollar exchange rate rose 4.3 won to 1483.3 won. Market volatility was driven by inflation concerns from Middle East conflicts and uncertainty about future U.S. monetary policy direction following the FOMC's three consecutive rate hold and the dissent of three members against dovish policy language.
sections.Industry & Technology: LG Energy Solution secured a major 10 trillion won contract to supply cylindrical batteries to BMW for next-generation electric vehicles, marking its first battery supply to BMW's pure EV platform. Samsung Electro-Mechanics recorded strong Q1 results with operating profit up 40% year-on-year, driven by robust demand for AI server components and advanced driver assistance systems for autonomous vehicles. Data center expansion and autonomous vehicle proliferation are expected to sustain growth momentum into Q2. The AI sector's rapid expansion is creating heightened demand for energy-efficient cooling systems in data centers.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul's apartment supply composition is shifting toward smaller 59-square-meter units, which offer lower construction costs and allow developers to increase unit numbers and sales revenue, while maintaining similar prices to the traditional 84-square-meter national standard units. Gangnam districts are experiencing price increases as rapid supply units are absorbed and lower-priced inventory declines. Monthly rent ratios exceeded 50% for the first time in Seoul during Q1 due to shortage of jeonse (long-term lease) properties and rising prices. Demand is concentrating in apartments below 1.5 billion won where lending restrictions are less restrictive, as the multi-property capital gains tax increase takes effect on May 10.
sections.International Economy: The Federal Reserve held rates steady at 3.50-3.75% for the third consecutive meeting, but three FOMC members dissented from dovish policy language, signaling internal divisions over future monetary policy and increasing uncertainty for global markets. Federal Reserve Chair Powell affirmed the Fed's independence from political pressure after President Trump previously threatened his removal for insufficient rate cuts. The ECB and Bank of England also held rates unchanged amid Middle East-related inflation concerns and economic uncertainty. Global central banks are cautiously monitoring energy price shocks and inflation risks while facing pressure from escalating geopolitical tensions.
sections.AI & Economy: U.S. big tech companies delivered beating first-quarter earnings despite early-year concerns about AI bubble, with major firms like Microsoft, Meta, Alphabet, and Amazon all exceeding market expectations, particularly driven by robust cloud computing growth. Microsoft's cloud service Azure revenue surged 40% year-on-year, demonstrating that AI infrastructure investments are generating substantial returns. Anthropic is negotiating funding at a valuation exceeding 900 billion dollars, positioning itself to potentially surpass OpenAI as the world's most valuable AI startup. Taiwan's GDP grew 13.69% in Q1, marking the highest growth in 39 years, largely driven by semiconductor industry expansion supporting AI demand globally.
sections.Others: Public institutions' debt ratio declined 6.4 percentage points to 174.1% year-on-year, while government employment expanded by 7,000 positions to 27,000 new hires across 342 public organizations. The government is implementing comprehensive foreign worker management system reforms, including easing employment site restrictions and extending work permit durations to address labor market structural changes. Woori Bank launched U.S. investment seminars supporting small and medium enterprises' overseas expansion amid rising localized production demand. The Korea Export-Import Bank convened the 2026 Korean Peninsula Future Vision Forum with government agencies to discuss peace cooperation and economic collaboration strategies for the region.
